scenario: Card scanned → DF entry started in the same session
signal: Server-held referral context from /invite/:code is attached when the artifact is created.
outcome: ATTRIBUTED · OBSERVED

scenario: QR scanned, prospect leaves, returns later by typing site00.com
signal: No server context survives unless within an approved window on the same browser.
outcome: UNATTRIBUTED until FD-R07; RO-19 manual correction with evidence

scenario: Return on the same device inside the approved window
signal: First-party, httpOnly referral context (opaque id, server-side lookup) still valid.
outcome: ATTRIBUTED · OBSERVED

scenario: Return after the window has closed
signal: Context expired server-side.
outcome: UNATTRIBUTED; correction allowed only with evidence

scenario: Two different partner links touched before the artifact exists
signal: Both touches recorded as visits.
outcome: ATTRIBUTION EXCEPTION (RO-18) → manual review until FD-R08

scenario: Partner link opened after the client's artifact already exists
signal: Visit recorded; artifact attribution is immutable once set.
outcome: PRESERVE PRIOR · no change

scenario: Prospect is an existing SITE 00 / DF client
signal: Email or business match to an existing artifact.
outcome: DISQUALIFIED (existing client) pending founder review

scenario: Partner refers itself, its owner or a related business
signal: Email domain / payee / owner match.
outcome: DISQUALIFIED (self-referral) pending review

scenario: Revoked code scanned
signal: Code status REVOKED.
outcome: Public page: card no longer active · BEGIN WITHOUT A REFERRAL · no attribution

scenario: Suspended partner's code scanned
signal: Partner SUSPENDED; code paused.
outcome: Begin unattributed; existing commissions follow FD-R19

scenario: Staging or test code used
signal: Code issued in a non-production environment.
outcome: TEST banner; never creates production attribution

scenario: Guessed, malformed or tampered code
signal: Code not found; high-entropy codes make guessing impractical.
outcome: Generic invalid page; rate-limited; security event logged; no partner name revealed

scenario: Partner id supplied by the client (query string, form field, local storage)
signal: Ignored; only the server-resolved code is evidence.
outcome: Never attributes; logged as tamper signal

scenario: Prospect forwards the link to another business
signal: Same code resolves for the second business.
outcome: ATTRIBUTED to the code's partner; FORWARDED signal noted for review

scenario: Scan on phone, finish on desktop
signal: Server context lives on the phone browser only.
outcome: UNAVAILABLE across devices unless continued via the private DF link; correction with evidence

scenario: Duplicate artifacts for the same business
signal: Two artifacts created by mistake.
outcome: One attribution per client; duplicate flagged; commission only on the surviving artifact

scenario: Payment refunded before eligibility
signal: Refund evidence before the trigger is satisfied.
outcome: Commission never becomes ELIGIBLE (stays NOT YET ELIGIBLE → REVERSED)

scenario: Partial refund after approval, before payout
signal: Basis reduced.
outcome: ADJUSTED with a correction entry; approval re-required

scenario: Chargeback after the payout was recorded PAID
signal: Dispute evidence from the processor.
outcome: DISPUTED; clawback / netting per FD-R06; payout reversal RO-17 only by founder

scenario: Partner terminated between referral and client payment
signal: Partner TERMINATED.
outcome: Commission handled per FD-R19; no automatic forfeiture

scenario: Verbal referral, no card or link used
signal: No digital touch exists.
outcome: Manual attribution with written evidence (RO-19); evidence class UNAVAILABLE
